nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Normative modeling used the Person-Based Similarity Index (PBSI) to assess normativeness of neuroanatomical profiles.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Personalised estimates of heterogeneity of SA, CT and SV brain pro /uniFB01 les were indexed with the novel Person-Based Similarity Index (PBSI), with two complementary applications. First, to assess the extent of within-diagnosis similarity or divergence of neuroanatomical pro /uniFB01 les between individuals. Second, using a normative modelling approach, to assess the ' normativeness ' of neuroanatomical pro /uniFB01 les in individuals at CHR-P.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Structural MRI measures: cortical surface area, cortical thickness, subcortical volume, and intracranial volume.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: We aimed to quantify the neuroanatomical heterogeneity in structural magnetic resonance imaging measures of cortical surface area (SA), cortical thickness (CT), subcortical volume (SV), and intracranial volume (ICV) in CHR-P individuals compared with healthy controls (HC), and in relation to subsequent transition to a /uniFB01 rst episode of psychosis.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: PBSI regression models adjusted for age and sex.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: All multivariable regression models were applied, adjusting for age and sex.
